name: Fever
generalGuidance: Rest and drink plenty of fluids. You can take over-the-counter medication like Paracetamol to reduce fever. If fever persists for more than 3 days, please see a doctor.

name: Headache
generalGuidance: Rest in a quiet, dark room. Drink water to stay hydrated. If the headache is sudden and very severe, please seek immediate medical help.

name: Body pain
generalGuidance: Rest and avoid strenuous activity. Gentle stretching or a warm bath might help. If the pain is severe or localized to one specific area, consult a doctor.

name: Cough
generalGuidance: Drink warm liquids like tea or warm water with honey. Use a humidifier if the air is dry. If you cough up blood or have trouble breathing, see a doctor immediately.

name: Cold
generalGuidance: Get plenty of rest and drink fluids. Warm saltwater gargles can help soothe a sore throat.

name: Sore throat
generalGuidance: Gargle with warm salt water. Drink warm liquids. Avoid smoking or passive smoke.

name: Vomiting
generalGuidance: Take small, frequent sips of water or oral rehydration solution (ORS) to prevent dehydration. Avoid solid food until vomiting stops.

name: Diarrhea
generalGuidance: Drink plenty of fluids, especially oral rehydration solution (ORS), to replace lost water and salts. Eat bland foods like rice or bananas.

name: Weakness
generalGuidance: Rest and ensure you are eating a balanced diet and drinking enough water.

name: Dizziness
generalGuidance: Sit or lie down immediately. Drink water. Avoid sudden movements.

name: Breathing difficulty
generalGuidance: URGENT WARNING: Breathing difficulty can be a sign of a serious condition. Please seek immediate medical attention or go to the nearest hospital.

name: Chest pain
generalGuidance: URGENT WARNING: Chest pain is a medical emergency. Please seek immediate emergency medical care.

name: Abdominal pain
generalGuidance: Rest and avoid heavy meals. If the pain is severe, sudden, or accompanied by fever or vomiting, see a doctor.
